notes.title: Surgery Mini-Game fixes, graphical fixes.
notes.content:
Surgery Mini-Game fixes, graphical fixes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36963686/3932bf8f2fd33e0f8a28dd59d8124fc225bb65d7.png[/img]
'New surgery mini-game fixes'

****CHANGES****

Added more effects to surgery mini-games,

Surgery mini-games now have set speeds, which changes on difficulty,

Added surgery times sign to recroom,

Game now saves room occupants, and discovered rooms,

Fixed time not counting up bug,

Added more detail to hospital,

Updated room backgrounds to have more shading,

All characters look higher res, more detailed now,

*****************************


Any ideas/suggestion leave a comment on the games steam forums!


PSD
